meta.parties: Nazeer Ahamed v. Bank of Ceylon

rules.statement: Execution of a judgment against an appellant should be allowed unless real and substantial justice requires that execution should be stayed, with the burden on the appellant to establish this exception.
rules.supporting_quote: "The principle appears to be that execution will be allowed unless 'real and substantial justice requires that execution should be stayed '. The burden of establishing this exception is upon the appellant"
